d:
Enjoy Kannu Kannu Kalethaga, A Timeless Lyrical Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Kaamana Billu, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music By Upendra Kumar.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Evergreen Melody, Presented By MRT Music. Sing Along With The Lyrics And Celebrate The Magic Of Classic Kannada Music, Kannada Old Songs, Lyrical Videos, And Evergreen Classics.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: J. Jayamma
Written by: Ashwini
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Anant Nag, Saritha
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
